planets.name: TOI-1533 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1533 with a 8.06-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-1533 c was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1533. Its orbit and size follow Mantovan et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
